complexity_ledger.narrative:
specs/results/scorecards/reading-discipline/GOAL-tags-earn-their-place/RD-05/RESULT.md is the narrative ledger, and references/architecture_tags.md §13 is the design side of it.
WHAT WAS ADDED, AND WHY IT IS NOT PROGRAM COMPLEXITY. One eval-harness module (`examples/validation/scorecards/architecture_tags.py`), one declared-scope registry (`subjects.toml`), two commands on `score_tools.py`, a third clause on R-H1 that `audit` executes, and 32 tests. NO TLA+, no adapters, no test-graph node, and no gate: the exit code of every tag command is 0 by construction and a test asserts it. The model delta is ZERO and was expected to be (`model_delta_expectation: none expected` in the plan).
WHAT IT BUYS. Architecture becomes a third comparability axis, so an architecture-scoped claim can be refused the way an example-scoped one is -- but ONLY on the one (dimension, value-pair) cell the record demonstrates, D3 on ab_quota_ledger, in one judge tier. On D1, D2, D4 and D5 a "different architecture" objection is not available at all.
THE MEASURED ALTERNATIVE THAT MATTERS. The epic owner's §6b ruling licensed deriving the tag from complexity figures; RD-05 could have taken the exemption the ruling explicitly forbade, or moved the file out of the scan's reach. Both were rejected and the INVARIANT'S STATEMENT was corrected instead: it now forbids a figure REFUSING (raise / assert / exit / a branch whose arm does one), and reports observation. Measured effect, archive tree, no homes: the one failure RD-04 escalated goes green and the like-for-like diff against the parent is exactly one member removed, nothing added.
THE FINDING THE CORE CANNOT EXPRESS. RD-05-DF-01: the scan that produced the escalation was firing on a subprocess exit status, not on a figure, because taint does not cross a function boundary -- so the clauses §9.9 escalated were never visible to it, and an empty refusal list is not coverage. The repair re-classifies what the scan sees and does not widen it.

refinement.detail:
SEARCHED, FOUND NONE, AND THE ONE REFINEMENT CONSIDERED WAS DECLINED ON RECORD. RD-05 adds no TLA+ representation at all: the model is unchanged and the complexity delta is zero against RD-04. The tag is an eval-harness surface under examples/validation/, which the plan's representation_scope keeps out of the model, and it refuses nothing about any artifact.
THE REFINEMENT CONSIDERED AND DECLINED: caching the derived tag per subject so that `audit` does not shell out to the complexity instrument eleven times per run (~1.1 s). It would remove the only expensive step in R-H1's third clause. It is declined because RE-DERIVATION IS THE ANTI-STALENESS PROPERTY -- a cached authority row is exactly the stale row the clause exists to catch, and R-H5's history is an unnumbered rule with no check that `audit` rejected within the minute. Priced instead, as RD-05-DF-05.
A second was considered and declined harder: making the derivation read a previously written complexity JSON instead of invoking the instrument. That would also have removed the file from two tripwires' reach -- which is the demonstrated blind spot at tests/test_instrument_demonstrations.py::test_the_blind_spot_is_real, and using it deliberately would be defeating a tripwire rather than satisfying one.

ticket.objective: PLACEHOLDER. Scope is defined by RD-04 and this ticket is REWRITTEN FROM ITS DESIGN BEFORE DISPATCH. It exists so the DAG and the evaluation have something to point at and so the research has a named consumer. What holds regardless of what RD-04 decides: a tag declared after the numbers are seen is not a tag; INCOMPARABLE is reported and never dropped; a tag value earns its place by demonstrating it changes a score or is deleted; R1 applies; no new gates -- a tag constrains what may be COMPARED and refuses nothing about the code; and changing the card requires a scorecard_version bump with the old anchors kept and a re-score under both versions.
